በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
ዐጸደ: ዐጸድ — enclosure, pen, courtyard (noun; construct 'pen of') · ዐጸደ ወይን 'vineyard' (lit. 'enclosure of wine'; ጒንደ ዐጸደ ወይን 'trunk of the vineyard', ch. 98)
ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began')
ዴዴ: ዴዴ — a word not identified, apparently a title or epithet of Christ after አነ 'I' (?) (possibly corrupt) (?)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ኢይባእ: ቦአ — enter, go in (3ms jussive; ኢ- negative)
ወርኩስ: ርኩስ — and unclean (ወ- 'and' + adjective, masc. sg.)
ወዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — and which is/was not (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs') · 'with, beside' (እንተ ኀቤሃ 'who were with her', ch. 55)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
አምሳሊሃ: አምሳል — her likeness (noun + -ሃ '3fs her', anticipating the owner)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ዐዘቅተ: ዐዘቅት — wells, pits (noun, accusative) · singular 'a well' (ዘከረየ ዐዘቅተ 'who dug a well')
ታሕቲት: ታሕታይ — lowest, the low (adjective, fem. ታሕቲት; in መትሕተ ታሕቲት 'the lowest of the low')
ወተይ: ተይ — and ? (ወ- + word unidentified; a cosmic element or torment beside fire, cf. ላዕለ እሳት ወተይ in ch. 101; sense unknown, left untranslated) (?)
መልዕልተ: መልዕልት — surface, upper part; upon (noun, construct, used as preposition) · above, on high, opposed to መትሕተ 'below' (ወትከውን መልዕልተ 'and you will be above')
ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
ወትረ: ወትር — always, continually (adverb, accusative; ወ- is part of the word)
እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all')
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
፯: ፯ — 7, spoken ሰብዐቱ (säbʿatu) 'seven'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'seven' (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days') · after a feminine noun (ዓመት ፯ 'seven years'), spoken ሰብዐ (säbʿa) (?); placed after its noun it may also be the ordinal 'seventh', ሳብዕ (sabʿ) (?)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘይሴወር: ሰወረ — one who is hidden (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, passive sense; root s-w-r 'hide') (?)
እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
መካን: መካን — place (noun) · barren (adjective, predicate: አነ መካን 'I am barren'; sense from context) (?)
ባዕደ: ባዕድ — other, foreign (adjective, accusative masc. sg., agreeing with አማልክተ)
ዘእንበሌየ: እንበለ — without, except (preposition; ዘ- 'that is' + -የ 'me', 1cs suffix)
በላዕሉ: ላዕል — above it (በ- + noun ላዕል 'upper part' as adverb + -ሁ '3ms it')
ወበምድር: ምድር — and on earth (ወ- + በ- + noun)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘይመስል: መሰለ — who resembles (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
እዴየ: እድ — my hand(s) (noun + -የ '1cs my'; 'work of my hands')
ሣረረታ: ሠረረ — she founded it (3fs perfect, G, written ሣረረ + ት + -ኣ 'it'; lemma uncertain) (?)
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun) · 'of the earth', ለ- as genitive link (ወእምስፍሓ ለምድር 'and from the breadth of the earth')
ለሰማይ: ሰማይ — the heaven, sky (ለ- marking the object + noun)
